ml of 10% w/v solution)-boiled for few minutes, not autoclaved; sucrose (20 ml of 10% 
w/v solution)-filter-sterilized; sulfur (10 g)-sterilized by steaming for 3 h on each of 
three successive days; polar lipid fraction (6 - 12ml)-prepared as described by W. Zillig 
et al. (1983), Syst. Appl. Microbiol. 4: 79 - 87; Na2S x 9 H2O (10 ml of 3% w/v 
solution)-autoclaved under nitrogen atmosphere.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust final pH to 5.2.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: 'Prepare the medium anaerobically under 100% nitrogen. The following
    constituents are prepared separately and added to the autoclaved mineral salt
    solution: Yeast extract (20 ml of 10% w/v solution)-boiled for few minutes, not
    autoclaved; sucrose (20 ml of 10% w/v solution)-filter-sterilized; sulfur (10
    g)-sterilized by steaming for 3 h on each of three successive days; polar lipid
    fraction (6 - 12ml)-prepared as described by W. Zillig et al. (1983), Syst. Appl.
    Microbiol. 4: 79 - 87; Na2S x 9 H2O (10 ml of 3% w/v solution)-autoclaved under
    nitrogen atmosphere.'
- step_number: 3
  action: MIX
  description: Sparge medium with 100% N2 gas mixture to make anoxic.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.
- step_number: 5
  action: MIX
  description: 'after autoclaving add the following sterile solutions:'
- step_number: 6
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: "Note: lipid fraction can be prepared from fresh or freeze-dried biomass.\
    \ Cells are disrupted by autoclaving or sonication, then filter-sterilized.\r\n\
    \r\nUse 5 g wet or 0,2 g dried biomass in 10 ml water or buffer, and use 10ml/l\
    \ of the sterile-filtered extract. Prepare under N2 conditions.\r\n\r\nModified\
    \ from  W. Zillig et al. (1983), Syst. Appl. Microbiol. 4: 79 - 87"
